CustomField.description: Check If Billing city and state are present, if one of them is present use it, otherwise, use shipping address
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCity)) && NOT(ISBLANK(BillingState)), BillingCity & ", " & BillingState, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCity)) || NOT(ISBLANK(BillingState)), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCity)), BillingCity, BillingState ), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(ShippingCity)) && NOT(ISBLANK(ShippingState)), ShippingCity & ", " & ShippingState, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(ShippingCity)) || NOT(ISBLANK(ShippingState)), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(ShippingCity)), ShippingCity, ShippingState ), NULL ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Combined City and State
